title: Why Do Sunsets Glow Red and Orange?
description: Ever wondered why sunsets glow? The Sun's light takes the long way through the air.
narration: Ever wondered why sunsets glow red and orange? At sunset the Sun is low, so its light crosses a lot more air. Tiny bits of air bounce the blue light off in every direction. That leaves the reds and yellows to sail straight to your eyes. Here's the cool part: extra stuff in the air can make sunsets even bolder. So at sunset, you're watching the blue light get steered away from you.
